title: GP10b pre-measurement artifact — Abandonment & the Renewal Campaign
milestone: GP10b — the consequence GP10a's ledger was built to measure: a zoned lot that has failed for ABAND_W consecutive months boards up, and a paid renewal campaign buys it back
baseline_commit: 127e74a — 'GP9b (checkpoint 2): fix-pass balance corrections; parked on D1/D2 + gate-scale conflicts — NOT shipped'. js tree c773c624dd0ffe2f141f5379434222ab8af45c24, js/sim.js at 8146 lines. The GP10b roadmap scope's line anchors are TWO milestones stale (they are written against a v17 tree); every anchor in this file is CURRENT-TREE.
purpose: Pins the baseline, the constants, the fixtures and every HEAD measurement BEFORE the implementation is judged, so verification compares against numbers that were written down rather than numbers that were discovered. GP7a's identical provenance gate failed for bundling; GP9a/GP10a/GP9b passed by splitting.

A2_the_central_finding.claim: Developed tiles do not survive to ABAND_W. The shipped UNPOWERED row's chance(0.35) decay (guarded on lvl>0, unpow>6) strips a dark lot to level 0 long before its distress counter reaches 15.
A2_the_central_finding.consequence: A lvl>0 guard on the abandonment predicate would make abandonment a small-single-digit-percent curiosity and would make any 'X% of developed lots' bar unreachable by construction. Scope §1's literal text (no lvl guard) is the only reachable predicate — and §1's own justification ('the tile KEEPS lvl[] so the derelict sprite has a size') is ALREADY FALSE on HEAD before GP10b touches anything.
A2_the_central_finding.decision_D5: SHIPPED with NO lvl guard, plus the TWO-FORM derelict expression in render.js (a boarded building at lvl>0, a boarded zone marker at lvl===0). The alternative that would preserve §1's intent — freezing lvl[] once a tile crosses a distress threshold — is a change to the SHIPPED UNPOWERED mechanic and was explicitly NOT taken.

this_pass_reproduction.note: REPRODUCED WITH A DIFFERENT FOOTPRINT and recorded as a discrepancy rather than silently adopted. Running the SAME pinned build_script at seed 4242 for 600 ticks and cutting every WIRE/WIREROAD tile in x∈[30,50] cut 92 wire tiles and left a 962-tile unpowered zoned footprint with 358 developed at the cut — roughly 1.9x the design's figures, so the design's fixture used a narrower cut or a different tick count.
this_pass_reproduction.shape_confirmed: The step at r15 is the ABAND_W window firing on the whole footprint at once — 488 -> 978 in one rollover. The A2 SHAPE (nothing developed survives; the flip is a cliff at exactly ABAND_W) reproduces even though the absolute counts do not.

A4_blight_radiates_pilot.design_supplied: A source S injected on a 4x4 cluster and diffused by recomputeMaps' first diffuse() call (poll, radius 3, rate 0.24) moves ring 1 strongly and ring 1-4 barely: S=50 -> ring1 -3.20 / ring1-4 -0.53; S=100 -> -6.25 / -1.02; S=400 -> -23.70 / -3.90 (cluster poll saturates at 255); S=3200 -> -35.95 / -7.21.
A4_blight_radiates_pilot.verdict: A '-15 over the 4-tile annulus' bar is UNREACHABLE AT ANY CONSTANT — ring 1-4 asymptotes near -7 as the cluster's own poll clamps into the Uint8Array and landv floors at 0. Ring 1 is the ring the kernel can actually move.
A4_blight_radiates_pilot.structural_confirmation_read_from_source: recomputeMaps calls diffuse() for poll, landv and traffic ONLY. crime[] is a pure per-tile formula and is NEVER diffused, so a crime ANNULUS cannot form at any constant. The only crime channel into the annulus is the landv*0.2 term, i.e. ring-1 crime rises by ≈0.2 x the ring-1 landv drop. The GP10b landv FOLD subtraction is applied per tile AFTER diffuse, so it moves the annulus by EXACTLY 0.
A4_blight_radiates_pilot.decision: The crime bar is measured ON the cluster; the annulus is reported as an observation.

A5_crosstalk_preconditions.verified_this_pass_in_browser: Object.keys(OV).length === 36 === OV_NAMES.length AFTER the GP10b edits — no new over[] id was introduced, so the >= OV.ZR auto-join lists are discharged by construction.
A5_crosstalk_preconditions.power_demand_null_result: On the DARK path an abandoned tile is ALREADY unpowered, so it was never counted in `demand` and the exclusion drops it by 0, not by N. Declared as an explicit null result, not a bug.
A5_crosstalk_preconditions.brownout_zero_draw: rngHashAt is a pure (dom, epoch, i) hash, never a cursor, so short-circuiting on !aband[i] consumes no draws at either the brownout or the y2k site.

A6_district_records_take_new_fields_for_.result: A districts[] record carrying {id,name,col,renewal:true,renewalSince:N} survives serialize -> deserialize -> serialize byte-intact through the wholesale serialize + field-preserving Object.assign restore. No new save key needed for the designation.

C11_re_pin_precedence.placement: ABANDONED inserted at GROWTH_GATES index 1 — after BURNING, before UNPOWERED.
C11_re_pin_precedence.why_forced: diagnoseTile reports firstGate's row as the PRIMARY verdict. On the dark path every abandoned tile is ALSO unpowered, so a row below UNPOWERED could never win the walk and the query box would never say 'Abandoned'. Measured in-browser: diagnoseTile returns code 'ABANDONED' as the PRIMARY verdict on both the lvl>0 and the lvl===0 abandoned lot.
C11_re_pin_precedence.row_shape: stop:true, apply:null — mandatory. An apply() here would spend the growth RNG cursor and turn a bounded post-abandonment re-pin into a global one.
declared_consequences: (a) unpow[i] stops incrementing on a boarded dark lot (UNPOWERED.apply no longer runs). unpow[] IS serialized and read by approvalCensus.zUnpow — declared, intended, and the reason C11 exists.

(b) the guarded chance(0.35) decay draw stops. On the dark path this costs EXACTLY ZERO draws, because the decay line short-circuits on c.lvl[i] > 0 first and the tiles are already at level 0 when they abandon.

(c) growthPass's unpow reset and its gridlock draw are skipped — as UNPOWERED already does for dark tiles, but a REAL skipped draw for POWERED abandoned lots. That is the entire source of the bounded re-pin, and C1 fences it: measured firstDiff (360) >= firstAband (359) on 20/20 seeds.
